policy.science: Prefer institutional/primary astronomy sources; use catalog-derived values where bulk coverage is required; do not invent unavailable position angles or physical sizes.
policy.mythology: Separate cultural/historical narrative from scientific facts; identify variants as variants; modern constellations are not assigned fabricated Greek myths.
policy.miyazawa_kenji: Tag only direct textual correspondences or conservative identifications; retain work title and quoted-expression keywords rather than speculative symbolism.
